subcategory_text: Processes to instill organizational privacy values within system/product/service development and operations are established and in place.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-1, SA-15 (Development Process, Standards, and Tools)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.27 (Secure system architecture and engineering principles)
GDPR Art. 25 (Data protection by design and by default)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.PO-02 (privacy roles and responsibilities)
implementation_examples: Define processes to instil organisational privacy values into system/product/service development (e.g., design-stage reviews) and into operations (e.g., change management)
Embed privacy-design checkpoints in the SDLC so that privacy is considered before architecture, not only before release
Track instillation outcomes in project close-out artefacts
assessment_objectives: Determine whether processes are in place to instil privacy values in development
Determine whether privacy-design checkpoints exist in the SDLC
Determine whether operations (change management, incident response) embody the privacy values
Determine whether instillation outcomes are measured
